title: Kingdom of Kittens
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: Given up to a hundred thousand integer lattice points, possibly repeated, the question is whether some triangle of positive area has every one of those points lying on its three sides, vertices included; the triangle's own corners need not be lattice points. Many such test cases arrive in one file, with half a million points in total, and each needs a yes or no answer.
